summary: BRBI BR Partners S.A. filed a Form 6-K on August 6, 2026, announcing interim dividends for Q2 2026. The Board approved R$18,899,226.72 total dividends, or R$0.06 per common or preferred share and R$0.18 per UNIT (BRBI11). Record date is August 14, 2026; ex-dividend date is August 17, 2026; payment date is August 28, 2026. This is a routine dividend notice, not a special situation such as capital returns or restructuring. No deal terms or strategic events are involved; the filing is standard disclosure by a foreign private issuer.
